title: A written whole-to-half transition with the same operator applied again at f107r.17
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED. Complete line sair chey losaiin chey is read prospectively as “Halve the whole; halve its half.” Three shared whole-word hypotheses give a conditional quarter outcome. A fixed cap and a measurement/list reading are genuine rivals; serial ownership is not established by repetition. The entire existing f107r.13–17 paragraph, every unknown group and all four chey occurrences are mandatory context. No operator, fraction, result or translation is claimed observed.

finite_local_semantic_contract.quantity_domain: Positive rational quantities x with one unchanged but unidentified dimension/unit U. Q>0 names the reference whole. No absolute amount or written decimal numeral is supplied.
finite_local_semantic_contract.operator: H(x)=x/2 for every chey in this prospective lexicon. It is not a different action at each occurrence.
finite_local_semantic_contract.postfix_production: QuantityMention HALVE. A quantity mention may be an explicit WHOLE or HALF expression; an unrecognized operand remains UNKNOWN rather than automatically becoming a quantity.
finite_local_semantic_contract.serial_binding: In the proposed closing line, the second quantity mention must denote the active output of the preceding operation on the same quantity lineage. Its meaning HALF_OF_Q asserts that the first output is Q/2. No fresh unrelated half-quantity is substituted to make this serial reading succeed.
finite_local_semantic_contract.second_application: The final chey takes that Q/2 output, hence H(H(Q))=Q/4.
finite_local_semantic_contract.no_unit_change: The two mentions cannot switch units or dimensions. Allowing a new unit after every operator would erase the numerical constraint.
finite_local_semantic_contract.physical_limit: This is a quantity-calculation interpretation. It does not assert cutting, discarding a second half, producing two physical objects or a material conservation account. A physical split interpretation would need those additional roles explicitly.
finite_local_semantic_contract.writing_limit: A two-clause postfix content hypothesis, not a decoder, fixed source-length record, new character code or established Voynich grammar. No substring meaning for s-, l-, -aiin or the chey family is exported.

concrete_rivals.name: Idempotent cap to a half
concrete_rivals.reading: Reduce the whole to at most half; apply the same cap to that half.
concrete_rivals.operator: C_Q(x)=min(x,Q/2) with the same reference Q throughout the clause.
concrete_rivals.first_step: C_Q(Q)=Q/2, so the written middle HALF could agree with both H and C_Q.
concrete_rivals.limit: No final quarter/half result word is independently identified after the final chey; this contrast is a prediction, not a measured discriminator.

concrete_rivals.name: Fixed subtraction
concrete_rivals.limit: This rival shares the assumed first result but differs from repeated proportional halving. Zero is a rival endpoint, not a newly translated word.

concrete_rivals.name: Two independent input quantities
concrete_rivals.reading: Halve a whole Q; separately halve an independently supplied half Q/2.
concrete_rivals.consequence: The final numerical result is still Q/4. Therefore a quarter endpoint alone would not prove that the second input came from the first operation.
concrete_rivals.limit: An explicit common quantity lineage is additional content. Identical quantity values are not individual identity; no per-occurrence identity is invented.

concrete_rivals.name: Quantity or unit presentation rather than an operation
concrete_rivals.reading: A whole measure; a half measure.
concrete_rivals.consequence: The two chey occurrences can have the same unit or measure-marker meaning without changing either quantity. This asserts two entries rather than a serial operation.
concrete_rivals.limit: The presence of two N-operator-shaped pairs alone cannot exclude this nominal construction. Its exact unit and the named fractions are also hypotheses.

general_ratio_and_symmetries.unfixed_ratio: If losaiin denotes rQ for an unknown positive ratio r and chey is a homogeneous scaling operator x↦rx, the same serial grammar predicts r²Q. Choosing r=1/2 is the concrete lexical hypothesis of this card, not a value estimated from the data.
general_ratio_and_symmetries.gauge: Changing Q or the global unit leaves all ratios unchanged. Without fraction meanings, an inverse or doubling account can be relabelled to mimic the formal roles. The surface alone has not selected a direction or numerical ratio.
general_ratio_and_symmetries.important_distinction: A second written quantity mention offers a place to hypothesize a first result, but does not certify that result or an independent before/after measurement.

design.why_this_is_a_new_raw_nomination: IDEA079 already asks about serial versus idempotent repetition. This card does not duplicate that generic question: it supplies one complete concrete four-group target, three exact candidate meanings, an explicitly written intermediate quantity candidate and its entire five-line paragraph. It does not claim to satisfy IDEA079’s experimental state-binding gate. The broader full-paragraph lexical consequences remain for separate review.

lexical_and_syntax_debts: All three meanings are new hypotheses; WHOLE and HALF are not recovered nouns or quantities.
Postfix action order and the second phrase’s status as the first output are unconfirmed.
The unit, reference whole, subject and quantity lineage are not established by the illustration or earlier paragraph.
All four paragraph occurrences of chey must keep one value; the two earlier operands are presently unresolved.
Other occurrences of sair, losaiin and chey could contradict this contract. They were not globally fitted or given exceptions.
A predicted quarter lacks a separately identified written endpoint. A correct arithmetic computation would validate the hypothesis’s consequences, not translate the manuscript.
design.prospective_decision: RAW retention only. Root must decide whether either whole own-edition paragraph supports a fixed common quantity/reference grammar before any target experiment. The IT ten-group prelude has no connected reading here. A synthetic Q/4 witness cannot decide the hypothesis because no quarter endpoint is presently identified in either target paragraph; even a quarter endpoint alone would not distinguish serial from independent input identity. Neither another repetition census nor a source-only halving calculator would establish the meanings.
